covers: The registers of the SAA1099 sound generator

entries.name: amplitude
entries.description: Channel amplitude: one register per channel, holding a left and a right level.
entries.behaviour: Register n sets channel n. Bits 3 to 0 are the left level and bits 7 to 4 the right level, each a 4-bit index into the amplitude table.

entries.name: frequency
entries.description: Channel frequency: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Register 0x08 plus n sets channel n's 8-bit frequency number. The octave registers give the rest of the pitch.

entries.name: octave
entries.description: Channel octaves: each register holds the octaves of two channels.
entries.behaviour: Bits 2 to 0 set the even channel's octave and bits 6 to 4 the odd one's. Register 0x10 serves channels 0 and 1, 0x11 channels 2 and 3, 0x12 channels 4 and 5.

entries.name: frequency enable
entries.description: Frequency enable: which channels output their tone.
entries.behaviour: Bit n enables the tone of channel n, for channels 0 to 5.

entries.name: noise enable
entries.description: Noise enable: which channels mix in their noise generator.
entries.behaviour: Bit n enables noise on channel n, for channels 0 to 5. Noise generator 0 serves channels 0 to 2 and generator 1 channels 3 to 5.

entries.name: noise generator
entries.description: Noise generator parameters: the rate of each of the two generators.
entries.behaviour: Bits 1 and 0 set generator 0 and bits 5 and 4 generator 1. Values 0 to 2 give fixed rates and 3 follows the frequency of channel 0 or channel 3.

entries.name: envelope generator
entries.description: Envelope generator control: register 0x18 for generator 0 and 0x19 for generator 1.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 enables it, bit 0 reverses the right output, bits 3 to 1 select the shape, bit 4 gives 3-bit resolution and bit 5 steps it on a register select instead of the channel tone. A write restarts the envelope.

entries.name: sound enable, reset
entries.description: Sound enable and reset: switches all channels on and resets the generators.
entries.behaviour: Bit 0 enables every channel; with it clear no sound is produced. Setting bit 1 synchronizes and resets the tone generators.
entries.differs: On a reset MAME reloads each channel's counter with its frequency; DOSBox-X zeroes it.
